title: 〜やら〜やら
meaning: … and … and so on (an unordered list, often overwhelming)
simpleExplanation: 〜やら〜やら lists two representative items from a larger, messy set: 準備やら手続きやらで忙しい. It suggests there are more items and that the speaker feels a little overwhelmed or confused. With adjectives (嬉しいやら恥ずかしいやら) it describes mixed feelings.
whenUsed: Both speech and writing, slightly colloquial. Common in complaints about being busy and in descriptions of chaotic scenes. A different use, 〜のやら〜のやら, expresses not knowing which (行くのやら行かないのやら).
formation: Noun やら Noun やら
Verb (dictionary form) やら Verb やら
い-adjective やら い-adjective やら
〜のやら〜のやら / 〜のやら分からない (I wonder whether)

rows.label: Example
cells: 準備やら手続きやらで忙しい
パンや牛乳などを買った

examples.ja: 引っ越しの準備やら手続きやらで、毎日忙しい。
examples.reading: ひっこしのじゅんびやらてつづきやらで、まいにちいそがしい。
examples.en: With moving preparations and paperwork and so on, I am busy every day.
examples.note: Overwhelmed by tasks: preparations and paperwork and more.

examples.ja: 嬉しいやら恥ずかしいやらで、顔が赤くなった。
examples.reading: うれしいやらはずかしいやらで、かおがあかくなった。
examples.en: Being happy and embarrassed at the same time, my face turned red.
examples.note: Mixed feelings: happy and embarrassed at once.

examples.ja: 泣くやら笑うやら、大騒ぎだった。
examples.reading: なくやらわらうやら、おおさわぎだった。
examples.en: With crying and laughing, it was quite a commotion.
examples.note: A chaotic scene: crying and laughing.

examples.ja: 引っ越しで、掃除やら荷造りやらで一日が終わった。
examples.reading: ひっこしで、そうじやらにづくりやらでいちにちがおわった。
examples.en: With cleaning and packing and everything else for the move, the day was gone.

examples.ja: 彼が本当に来るのやら来ないのやら、はっきりしない。
examples.reading: かれがほんとうにくるのやらこないのやら、はっきりしない。
examples.en: Whether he is really coming or not is unclear.
examples.note: 〜のやら〜のやら: uncertainty about which.

similarGrammar.difference: Casual examples without the overwhelmed nuance.
Two items of the same tendency, stated as facts.
Similar to やら, but with a critical, complaining tone.

commonMistakes.wrong: パンやら牛乳やらを買った。(neutral shopping)
commonMistakes.right: パンや牛乳などを買った。
commonMistakes.why: For a neutral list use や〜など; やら implies confusion or excess.

commonMistakes.wrong: 嬉しいやら恥ずかしい。
commonMistakes.right: 嬉しいやら恥ずかしいやら。
commonMistakes.why: Use やら after both items.

commonMistakes.wrong: 勉強やら仕事やらで、暇だ。
commonMistakes.right: 勉強やら仕事やらで、忙しい。
commonMistakes.why: The main clause should reflect the overwhelmed feeling.

usageNotes: やら〜やらで is the most common frame, followed by 忙しい / 大変だ.
With emotions: 嬉しいやら悲しいやら, 驚くやら呆れるやら.
Noun + やら can also stand alone: 何やら (something or other).
jlptTips: If the sentence ends with 忙しい / 大変だ / 大騒ぎ and lists two items, choose やら〜やら.
Distractors include とか, や, も〜ば〜も. Look for the overwhelmed or confused nuance.
〜のやら〜のやら appears in reading as 'not knowing which'.
